description: Data scientist and software engineer with 12 years of experience designing, conducting, and communicating complex research. Partnered with faculty, staff, and students at dozens of leading universities on data management, hypothesis formulation, and mathematical and statistical modeling.

Broad software toolkit spanning DevOps, full-stack application development, performance benchmarking, ETL, and cloud deployment. Specialize in migrating legacy file-based data formats to cloud-performant standards. Regularly host workshops and hackathons that train researchers in current technologies and best practices. Strong foundation in high-dimensional time series analysis, nonlinear dynamics, and machine learning.
